title: Story premise EDU093: The Sign-In Prompt Nobody Started
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (consumer digital literacy). Hook: Did you start the sign-in this prompt is asking about? Takeaway/theme: Unexpected authentication prompts deserve verification rather than automatic approval.
description: A user wants to respond to a sudden approval prompt, but assumes every notification means an action they initiated. A timeline checks for a matching sign-in and routes the unexplained prompt to official account guidance.
